nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
ARCHVIZ v0.2 · LOCAL SDXL
1. Default INSPECT does not generate. Demo is a synthetic test image.
2. EXECUTE + Facade RUN → candidate. Other passes stop.
3. Copy attempt_id from report to target_id. Review image. Set reviewed=true + note, then ACCEPT or REJECT and Queue.
4. After ACCEPT set Facade CACHE, Road RUN, action EXECUTE. Repeat.
5. run_nonce++ explicitly regenerates. Changing seed invalidates all affected CACHE.
FGB OFF = pass-through SKIP, not CACHE. Read README_RU.md.

nodes.title: ORIGINAL · replace demo for real work
MASK ENGINE · contract
widgets_values:
VARIANT 01 MASK ENGINE
AUTO and PREPARED are independent lazy branches.
AUTO: ORIGINAL → SAM3 → AUTO Mask Contract.
PREPARED: file paths → PREPARED Mask Contract.
Mask Source Switch executes ONLY the selected branch and exposes previews.
Pass receives AP_MASKSET by cable. Generation baseline remains v0.2.
